newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF receives 27.5 bln yen from private sector--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: MOF receives 27.5 bln yen from private sector--BOJ.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) received 27.5 billion yen from the private sector in July through its special foreign exchange account, Bank of Japan (BOJ) data showed on Friday.
The ministry manages Japan's external reserves, which stood at $222.305 billion at the end of June.
Analysts said most of the money MOf received came from private-sector purchases of financing bills (FBs) in July, which totalled 66 billion yen.
The private-sector institutions comprise commercial banks, foreign central banks, municipal governments, public funds and quasi-governmental organisations.
